BUSINESS STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: BUSINESS STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Measure rainfall only
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Name the president
   D. Replace the compass rose

2. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Social Responsibility of Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Social Responsibility of Business never happens in Kenya.
   C. Treat Social Responsibility of Business as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business.

3. Which statement about Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Glo as rumours only.

4. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

5. Which statement about Money is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Money with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Money.
   C. Say Money never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Money as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum as rumours only.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Social Responsibility of Business 2.4 Entrepreneurship 2.5 Production 2.6 Consum.

7. Which statement about Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business .
   C. Explain Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Budgeting in Business 1.4 Banking 2.0 Business and Its Environment 2.1 Business  as rumours only.

8. Which statement about Budgeting in Business is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Budgeting in Business never happens in Kenya.
   B. Explain Budgeting in Business with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Budgeting in Business.
   D. Treat Budgeting in Business as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Banking is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Banking with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Treat Banking as rumours only.
   C. Say Banking never happens in Kenya.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Banking.

10. Which statement about Business Goals is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Business Goals never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Business Goals.
   C. Explain Business Goals with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Business Goals as rumours only.

11. Which statement about Business Activities is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Business Activities as rumours only.
   B. Explain Business Activities with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Business Activities.
   D. Say Business Activities never happens in Kenya.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nairobi
   C. Nakuru
   D. Kisumu

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Satisfaction 3.0 Government and Global Influence in Business 3.1 Public and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Consumer Satisfaction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance 3.2 International Trade 4.0 Financial Records in Business 4.1 Bus and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Public Finance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
